description.en: Returns the dialogue message ID to show for an NPC encounter, given the outcome of the challenge (e.g. win/lose/not-yet-played).
Index of the encounter, from CMND_GET_ENCCHR_INDEX.
Which dialogue variant to fetch (e.g. a win/lose/default outcome code).
Message ID for the dialogue to show.

example.code:
// Get the dialogue to show after losing the encounter's challenge
local mesID = CMND_GET_ENCCHR_TALK_ID(encIndex, lose);
